<!-- GA4 G-G6P1S31J8L. Needs Relaxed CSP and https://www.googletagmanager.com in the site's trusted script sites. Page view pattern from the LWR guide, Examples: Use Google Analytics in LWR Sites. The route change page view is sent from the plain script below, because the privileged iframe never receives the outer window's pushstate event. -->
<script>
  window.history.pushState = (f => function pushState() {
    var ret = f.apply(this, arguments);
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('pushstate'));
    if (typeof window.gtag === 'function') {
      window.gtag('event', 'page_view', {
        page_location: location.href,
        page_title: document.title
      });
    }
    return ret;
  })(history.pushState);
  // Components cannot see window.gtag from inside their sandbox. c/analyticsService dispatches
  // a cancelable portfolio-analytics event on the document instead, and this listener sends it
  // with only plain text, number and true or false values, then cancels the event to say it was sent.
  document.addEventListener('portfolio-analytics', function (event) {
    var detail = event && event.detail;
    var name = detail && detail.name;
    if (typeof window.gtag !== 'function' || typeof name !== 'string' || !/^[a-z0-9_]{1,40}$/.test(name)) {
      return;
    }
    var source = (detail && detail.params) || {};
    var params = {};
    Object.keys(source).forEach(function (key) {
      var value = source[key];
      if (typeof value === 'string' || typeof value === 'number' || typeof value === 'boolean') {
        params[key] = value;
      }
    });
    window.gtag('event', name, params);
    event.preventDefault();
  });
</script>
<x-oasis-script async src="https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=G-G6P1S31J8L"></x-oasis-script>
<x-oasis-script hidden="true" exported-global-names="gtag,dataLayer">
  window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
  function gtag() { dataLayer.push(arguments); }
  gtag('js', new Date());
  gtag('config', 'G-G6P1S31J8L', { cookie_domain: 'auto' });
</x-oasis-script>
